about: Hooton & Chen is a two-name Portland practice on Huber Street that publishes in English, Spanish and Chinese, and describes itself as a small firm giving individual attention.

A free consultation, published. Its Google listing averages a flat five stars across 173 reviews. It states no fee model, publishes only a blog of the trust pages pillar D looks for, and names no attorney on the pages we could reach.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Oregon does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Oregon does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Businesses register (data.oregon.gov tckn-sxa6), published as open data by the Oregon Secretary of State and could not identify this firm in it: no entity whose name contains the firm's name. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 173 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2018-11-21, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
